gen-gf-unica-one-gf-chocolate-classical-: Broad-nibbed pen strokes that never curl shut give the body a sizable, modern read under Unica One. Chocolate Classical Sans keeps a pen's motion; the heading keeps a ruler's.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-comme: Every stroke in Unica One is drawn at a single thickness, with visible daylight inside each curve, and it looks commanding. Comme then gives smooth, tall-bodied sans text a place to settle.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-duru-sans: Commanding lettering in Unica One holds a constant line width, with visible daylight inside every curve. Duru Sans lets its generously opened small letters dominate the line, ascenders barely showing.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fresca: Fresca reads openly, its apertures keeping counters connected to the outside and its short ascenders sitting above big bowls. Give Fresca a little extra size next to Unica One.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-funnel-sans: Unica One is all commanding, uniform strokes and big open curves, with daylight showing inside every one of them. Funnel Sans backs it with widths that hold steady from stem to curve.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-golos-text: Golos Text fills the line with a tall x-height. Unica One, by contrast, does its best work as a commanding display voice, while Golos Text does its best as quietly approachable running text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Ruler-drawn punch: Unica One keeps a constant line width, with daylight inside every curve, over a sans-serif body. Hedvig Letters Sans adds a clear gap where the c ends, and small letters nearly capital height.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-guntur: Unica One is commanding, with every stroke at a single thickness. Hind Guntur sets tall, stamped-metal-like lowercase against that, with wide gaps between curve ends and stems and no thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-hind-siliguri: Loud lines, then a soft, humming sans-serif. Unica One shows daylight in every constant-weight curve, while Hind Siliguri hums along in flat gray, its rounds gapped like a cracked bangle.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-matangi: Commanding up top: Unica One keeps a constant stroke thickness, with daylight in every curve. And Matangi presses rounded, open letters into a hefty lowercase body, like twine on a flat surface.
